name: Kall (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over black, charged towards the hoist with the municipal arms of Kall (a lion and an eagle above crossed tools).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Cologne of 8 June 1990 the municipality of Kall was granted the right to bear a flag as a hoisted flag, described as white and black striped 1:1 with the arms shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Kall arms — lion, eagle and crossed tools
